functions.query: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) order by q.role_oid::oid,q.function_oid::oid),'[]'::jsonb) from (select r.oid::text role_oid,p.oid::text function_oid,p.pronamespace::text schema_oid,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,p.pronamespace,'USAGE') schema_usage,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,p.pronamespace,'CREATE') schema_create,has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE') execute from pg_roles r cross join pg_proc p where r.oid=any(%s::oid[]) and p.oid=any(%s::oid[])) q

tables.query: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) order by q.role_oid::oid,q.relation_oid::oid),'[]'::jsonb) from (select r.oid::text role_oid,c.oid::text relation_oid,c.relnamespace::text schema_oid,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,c.relnamespace,'USAGE') schema_usage,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,c.relnamespace,'CREATE') schema_create,has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT') "select",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT') "insert",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE') "update",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'DELETE') "delete",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'TRUNCATE') "truncate",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'REFERENCES') "references",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'TRIGGER') "trigger",has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'MAINTAIN') "maintain" from pg_roles r cross join pg_class c where r.oid=any(%s::oid[]) and c.oid=any(%s::oid[])) q

columns.query: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) order by q.relation_oid::oid,q.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) from (select a.attrelid::text relation_oid,a.attnum,a.attname,a.atttypid::text,a.attacl,a.attisdropped from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=any(%s::oid[]) and a.attnum>0) q

column_privileges.query: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) order by q.role_oid::oid,q.relation_oid::oid,q.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) from (select r.oid::text role_oid,a.attrelid::text relation_oid,a.attnum,has_column_privilege(r.oid,a.attrelid,a.attnum,'SELECT') "select",has_column_privilege(r.oid,a.attrelid,a.attnum,'INSERT') "insert",has_column_privilege(r.oid,a.attrelid,a.attnum,'UPDATE') "update",has_column_privilege(r.oid,a.attrelid,a.attnum,'REFERENCES') "references" from pg_roles r cross join pg_attribute a where r.oid=any(%s::oid[]) and a.attrelid=any(%s::oid[]) and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped) q
